question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who looks at the negative side of everything
solution:
The correct answer is **"Pessimist."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **"pessimist"** is someone who always looks at the negative side of things. (निराशावादी व्‍यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** *My friend is such a pessimist that she always expects the worst to happen.*
 
 
 
• *​*One who looks at the negative side of everything is called **"Pessimist."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Optimist** - A person who always looks at the positive side of things. (आशावादी व्यक्ति)
 
• **Activist** - A person who campaigns for social or political change. (किसी राजनैतिक या सामाजिक व्‍यवस्‍था में परिवर्तन लाने वाले दल का सदस्य; उत्‍साही कार्यकर्ता)

 
 
• **Racist** - A person who believes in the superiority of a particular race. (जातिवादी)
